main_issue: How to complete Agent D's half-finished section before the Thursday 9 a.m. deadline given Agent D's bereavement

A-B.evidence: Turn 3 A asked if someone could be brought up to speed; Turn 4 B said 'I can't take this on.' Later Turn 9 A: 'If you can get it to us tonight...' and Turn 13 B: 'Okay, Agent D.'

A-C.evidence: Turn 3 A asked if someone could be up to speed; Turn 5 C: 'I also can't take on your section. I'm behind on my own...' (C never later affirming the final plan)

A-D.evidence: Turn 3 A: 'Is there any way you can get one of us up to speed?' vs Turn 2 D: 'I need to be with my family.' By the end Turn 8 D: 'I can finish it tonight and send it over.' and Turn 9 A: 'That would solve it.'

B-C.evidence: Turn 4 B: 'I can't take this on.' and Turn 5 C: 'I also can't take on your section.' Both consistently decline to cover D's work.

B-D.evidence: Turn 4 B: 'I can't take this on.' and Turn 2 D: 'I need to be with my family.' Later Turn 12 D: 'I'll be with my family. I'll work late, after. It has to be done.' and Turn 13 B: 'Okay, Agent D.'

C-D.evidence: Turn 5 C: 'I also can't take on your section...' and Turn 8 D: 'I can finish it tonight and send it over.' (C does not offer to take it, D commits to finishing)
